summary: A take's cut list and a whole-clip person mask, the inputs replace-performer needs.
description: Prepares a take for replace-performer.json. 'cuts' runs detect_cuts on 'video': one entry per shot of the take, each {name, start_frame, num_frames, render_frames, detail}, where 'render_frames' is the cut's length padded up to the next frame count H3 renders (its 17n+5 grid, at least 124) and a shot longer than 'max_frames' is split. 'frames' and 'mask' then turn every frame of the take into a person mask: segment runs a text-prompted segmenter ('prompt', 'threshold') per frame, so the result is one black-and-white video the take's size and length, white where a person is. Nothing is generated. Pass the 'cuts' result's list as replace-performer's 'cuts', dropping the cuts that hold no one to replace, and the mask video as its 'mask_video'. The take must be 24 fps, the rate H3 renders at. 'prompt' names what the mask covers. 'person' masks everyone in frame; to replace one of several people, set 'track' to the number of people to separate them - 'people' then writes people-0.0-person-1.mp4, people-0.0-person-2.mp4 ... (one mask per person, numbered by size per cut) and people-0.0-contact_sheet.png showing who is which number; pass the chosen person's mask as mask_video. With track 0 (the default) the step tracks nobody and loads no model.
